system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

data_description.dataset_name: Sentinel-5P Near Real-Time Total Column Ozone (O3)

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global near real-time total column ozone from Sentinel-5P TROPOMI sensor. The Earth Engine collection provides global atmospheric ozone measurements from surface to top of atmosphere.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Daily O3 measurements from 2018-07-10 to present in the Earth Engine asset.

band_semantics.O3_column_number_density: Total atmospheric column of O3 between surface and top of atmosphere (mol/m^2)

data_description.important_note: Ozone is critical for UV radiation shielding in the stratosphere and acts as a cleansing agent in the troposphere. This dataset enables monitoring of ozone layer recovery following the Montreal Protocol and tracks ground-level ozone pollution.

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: O3 column number density in mol/m^2. Total column represents integrated ozone from surface to top of atmosphere.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Quality filtering based on ozone_effective_temperature [180-260K] and fitted_root_mean_square <= 0.01 is recommended.

data_description.data_source: European Space Agency Sentinel-5P TROPOMI mission via Google Earth Engine
